title: Image thumbnail
responsibility: Loads a small preview of one recorded design image.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplied to the image-URL helper for preview retrieval and effect cleanup.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.entityId
inputs.description: Required entity identifier in the image request.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.version
inputs.description: Required design-version identifier in the image request.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.sha256
inputs.description: Required image hash in the request; this view does not independently verify bytes.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.title
inputs.description: Required alternative text for the thumbnail.

outputs.name: ImageThumbnail
outputs.description: Image when the helper supplies a nonempty URL; otherwise Preview unavailable, including while loading. Ignores the helper’s error argument, so loading and failure are not distinguished.
